topic: Status update on metric aggregation plan
summary_markdown: The initial plan for storing network metrics was deemed suitable for storage but inadequate for period aggregation. A new plan is currently being implemented, with a staging version 0.1 expected to be deployed today or early next week, depending on feedback and development time.
decisions: A new plan will be used for aggregating network metrics.
action_items: [p1] will test the deployed staging version 0.1.
